canonical_sql_candidate: WITH planned AS (SELECT document_id,product_id,SUM(planned_qty_milli) AS planned_qty_milli FROM INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES GROUP BY document_id,product_id), executed AS (SELECT dl.document_id,dl.product_id,SUM(CASE WHEN d.document_type='TRANSFER' THEN CASE WHEN m.movement_role='SOURCE' THEN ABS(m.qty_delta_milli) ELSE 0 END ELSE ABS(m.qty_delta_milli) END) AS executed_qty_milli FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS m JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES dl ON dl.document_line_id=m.document_line_id JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d ON d.document_id=dl.document_id WHERE d.document_status='POSTED' GROUP BY dl.document_id,dl.product_id) SELECT d.document_id,d.document_no,d.document_type,d.document_status,p.sku,p.base_unit,pl.planned_qty_milli,COALESCE(ex.executed_qty_milli,0) AS executed_qty_milli FROM INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d JOIN planned pl ON pl.document_id=d.document_id JOIN PRODUCTS p ON p.product_id=pl.product_id LEFT JOIN executed ex ON ex.document_id=pl.document_id AND ex.product_id=pl.product_id ORDER BY d.document_id,p.product_id
